office_does: The auditor keeps the county's financial records and budget, audits bills, runs elections, handles vehicle licensing and marriage licenses, and records deeds.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Nicci Bergseng (Prefers Independent Party), auditor since at least 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Wahkiakum County Auditor, elected unopposed in 2022; the only candidate.
